name: Calendar & Reminder Tool
description: Manage scheduled events, tasks, and calendar reminders. Use this to schedule new reminders, list upcoming tasks, or cancel events requested by the user.

title.description: The title or description of the reminder/event. Required for 'create'.

scheduledTime.description: The target time in ISO format or relative terms (e.g. '2026-07-25T15:00:00+07:00' or 'in 15 minutes'). Required for 'create'.

reminderId.description: The unique ID of the reminder to delete. Required for 'delete'.
